about_the_game:
You’ve been abducted by an alien. Not a probing, peace-seeking, high-council alien — no, this one’s rude, smug, and apparently hates your very existence. Welcome to The Reflex Lab, a story driven puzzle/reflex game where success gets you mocked, and failure gets you mocked more!

Customize your test subject and dive into a gauntlet of strange, fast-paced trials inside a the aliens poorly constructed and unethical facility. As you pass each challenge, you’ll begin to unravel fragments of a deeper mystery:

Who is this alien? Why did he kidnap you? Did you leave the oven on before you left?

Key Features

  • Narrative Mystery: Piece together the alien’s origins and the lab’s true purpose as you progress.  

  • Alien Attitude: Endure insults and snarky comments from your extraterrestrial captor — or earn his respect... probably not

  • Custom Character Creation: Design your own human lab rat before the experiments begin

  • Reflex and skill based gameplay: The completion of each is dependent on you and your skill, or your lack of skill

  • Your failure and success changes the story: As you progress through the game, your decisions and success will effect the ending and the dialogue options as the game progresses

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 SP1+ or Windows 10
  • Processor: Dual Core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 3000 or better
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated
  • Additional Notes: Keyboard recommended. Designed for 16:9 displays.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: Quad Core 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel UHD Graphics 600 / NVIDIA GT 710 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 300 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or better
  • Additional Notes: Runs well on low-spec laptops and older desktops.

short_description: You've been kidnapped by an evil (and extremely rude) alien. To escape, you’ll have to complete a series of reflex, skill and patience based trials in his poorly constructed laboratory. Will you survive the alien’s twisted tests and escape? Or will you end up like his last batch of “lab rats”?
